+

+

+    assert handle_count_users({"domain": "EXAMPLE.COM"}) == (200, {"count": 2})
+
+def test_count_users_domain_no_match():
+    assert handle_count_users({"domain": "other.com"}) == (200, {"count": 0})
+
+def test_count_users_invalid_domain_type():
+    assert handle_count_users({"domain": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid domain"})
+
+def test_count_users_empty_domain():
+    assert handle_count_users({"domain": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid domain"})
